G1_unambiguity.justification: The assignment requirements, output format, and lexicographic tie-break are stated clearly, and the additional numerical conditions have an unambiguous meaning.

G2_completeness.justification: All necessary bounds, input formats, assignment values, feasibility conditions, output cases, and tie-breaking rules are provided.

G3_faithfulness.justification: The added capacity, identifier-sum, and structural conditions are redundant under the stated bounds and assignment values, so the rewrite asks for the same assignments and outputs as the original.

G4_naturalness.justification: Although readable, the tournament framing and especially the redundant “Capacity Conservation,” “Identifier Bounds,” and structural-property requirements feel contrived and unnecessarily inflate the statement.
